title: A job you love or a job that pays?
situation: You write a blog in English about the choices young people face after finishing school. Many of your readers have asked you the same question: "Is it better to have a well-paid job you don't enjoy or a job you love that pays less?" Write a blog post in which you discuss the question.
situationHu: Angol nyelvű blogodban arról írsz, hogy jobb-e egy jól fizető, de nem szeretett munka, vagy egy kevésbé jól fizető, de szeretett állás.

points.text: say what young people in your country consider important when choosing a career
discuss the advantages of a high salary
explain why job satisfaction might be more important in the long run
say which you would choose and why

usefulPhrases.en: What would you choose? Let me know in the comments.
usefulPhrases.hu: Ti mit választanátok? Írjátok meg kommentben!
